title: Containers on AWS
summary: Docker basics, then how AWS runs containers: Amazon ECS with the EC2, Fargate and Managed Instances capacity options, its three IAM roles, load balancing, EFS and EBS storage, service and cluster auto scaling and event-driven tasks; Amazon ECR for images (scanning, lifecycle, replication); Amazon EKS for Kubernetes with its node types and CSI storage; plus ECS/EKS Anywhere and ECS Express Mode.
